Job Description

Would you like to use your property management experience to help develop solutions that create real value? As a Property Manager at Netcompany, you will work with technical teams and customers to turn real-life experience into solutions that improve property management through a data driven approach that ensure the right usage of AI and digital capabilities.

Responsibilities

Netcompany is looking for a Property Manager to take a key role in the continued development of our property management solutions. The role is for an experienced, operational property manager who knows the reality of managing properties day to day and can use that experience to help shape better digital solutions. You will bring hands-on knowledge of property management into the product development process and work closely with technical and refinement teams to ensure that solutions reflect real-life processes, challenges and user needs. You will also contribute to customer dialogue, where your practical experience helps create credibility and a strong understanding of how the product can support customers in their daily work.

A significant part of the role involves leveraging your property management experience in product improvements, customer insight and relevant market activities. You will participate in customer meetings, support pre-sales activities and contribute to business development through market dialogue and feedback from existing and potential customers. This is not a sales role; your contribution is your professional expertise and ability to understand the customer's operational reality, ask the right questions and help connect their needs with the capabilities of the product.

Your responsibilites will typically include:

• Ensuring the product delivers value, automation potential and efficiency across the property management value chain

• Working closely with the technical team and refinement team on product development

• Supporting business development and sales activities through market dialogue, customer feedback and pre-sales activities

• Participating in customer meetings and other client-facing activities

• Building trust and credibility in customer dialogues

About you

To succeed in this role, you:

• Have solid operational experience working as a property manager

• Contribute with operational experience across a property portfolio, including the full complexity of Danish regulatory requirements (eg.  cost control rent 'OMK', free market rent, taxes, duties and rates, operational budgets)

• Have experience across residential, commercial and mixed properties including the customer reporting requirements a property manager faces

• Have experience as a power user or super user of a property management software system

• Have full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

We provide a structured career model that allows you to build on your existing experiences.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will support your development and help you achieve your personal and professional goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague in management gives you concrete insights into the various business areas and responsibilities that match your interests and desires.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars tailored to you and where you are in your career. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills. Participating alongside colleagues from across the company helps you build a solid network and provides a strong foundation for your career at Netcompany, both professionally and socially.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand your network.

Send us an application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance. #LI-SA1

Are you analytical, detail-oriented, and curious about how data supports business decisions in Supply Chain and S&OP?

About the role

We are looking for a Student Assistant to support our S&OP & Analytics team at Orifarm. This is a great opportunity to gain hands-on experience with data, reporting and business processes in an international pharma company.

As a Student Assistant in S&OP & Analytics, you will support our monthly S&OP cycle, reporting landscape and ad-hoc analyses. You will work closely with specialists in the team and help ensure high data quality, transparency, and timely insights for the business, ideally you will start June 2026.

The role is part-time (typically 2–3 days per week) and designed to fit alongside your studies.

Your key tasks will include:

• Supporting S&OP and Supply Chain reporting (Excel & Power BI)

• Maintaining and updating existing Excel-based reports (e.g. inventory status, inventory forecast, service and inventory views)

• Assisting with data preparation, validation, and consolidation across sources

• Supporting development and maintenance of Power BI reports and dashboards

• Documenting reports, data sources, and recurring processes

• Contributing to ad-hoc analyses and local improvement projects within S&OP & Analytics

Within the S&OP team you will report to the Senior Demand Planning Specialist.

Who are you?

You enjoy working with data and thrive in a structured environment with recurring tasks. You are curious, responsible, and motivated by turning data into clear and useful insights.

We imagine that you:

• Are studying Supply Chain Operations, Management or Manufacturing, Process Engineering, Business, Economics or similar

• Have strong skills in Excel (e.g. formulas, XLOOKUP, structured data sets)

• Are comfortable working with large data sets and detail-oriented

• Have an analytical mindset and a pragmatic, can-do attitude

• Communicate clearly and enjoy collaborating with others

It is a plus (but not a requirement) if you:

• Have experience with Power BI or Power Query

• Understand S&OP or supply chain processes

• Have experience working with ERP data (e.g. AX / Dynamics)

Who are we?

You will join the S&OP & Analytics team and work closely with specialists focused on S&OP processes, local market and supply reviews and data-driven decision support. The team plays a key role in balancing Supply & Demand, driving transparency and developing data insights for the Orifarm business. We value collaboration, trust, and an informal working culture with room for learning and responsibility.

We offer:

• A relevant student job with hands-on experience in Supply Chain, S&OP and analytics

• Close collaboration with experienced S&OP and analytics professionals

• Flexible working hours aligned with your studies

• Personal and professional development in an international organization

• A supportive and informal team environment

Why should you work for Orifarm?

As a student assistant at Orifarm, you will join 70 other talented student assistants from diverse backgrounds in our Student Network (SNO). SNO organizes social and professional events, allowing you to expand your network and connect across functions.

Furthermore, as a student assistant, you will not only experience an exciting student job where you can apply theory to practice but also have the opportunity to experience an enriching internship and perhaps even collaborate on a bachelor’s or master’s thesis. You will experience a great and educational start to your professional journey with us!

Our international setting offers great opportunities for growth and career advancement. Additionally, you can enjoy a great canteen with various delicious and healthy meals at our offices and take advantage of the massage service available at our office in Odense. We also prioritize social events and gatherings to ensure that our employees feel connected and engaged with each other.

When we have good results, every employee, including student workers, is part of our bonus scheme.

About Orifarm

Everyone should have access to modern medicine. High costs or lack of access to pharmaceuticals should never impact our possibility to receive treatment or relief and live a healthy life. At Orifarm, we aim to bring healthy days by making modern healthcare a better deal for the people and the societies we serve.

Working towards our vision, we create access to affordable, high-quality pharmaceuticals and healthcare products by challenging markets and always seeking new opportunities. With our core values paving the way, we always act responsibly and constantly with our customers at the center of our attention. And everything we do is driven by our sole purpose:

For as many as possible, as healthy a day as possible.

Our history goes back to 1994 when Orifarm was founded in Denmark by Hans and Birgitte Bøgh-Sørensen. Since then, Orifarm has grown from a small nine-person company into an international company operating globally in 15 countries. Today, Orifarm is Europe's largest parallel importer of pharmaceuticals and Denmark's largest supplier of pharmaceuticals, with more than 2,200 employees.

We encourage everyone to apply

At Orifarm, we welcome people from all backgrounds, recognizing that the best outcomes come from a diverse and inclusive work environment. Our commitment is to create an environment where different perspectives and skills drive innovation and contribute to a sustainable future. By creating such an environment, we are confident that we can achieve better results together.

Job Location

Odense (HQ).

Need further information?

[If you need further information about the job, please contact Anders Nørgaard Jensen, Senior Demand Planning Specialist at anjen@orifarm.com.

We are often looking for new employees to help us grow and therefore, we may have other interesting opportunities for you. Follow us on LinkedIn to receive updates on our business activities and job opportunities: https://www.linkedin.com/feed/

Application deadline

Ongoing recruitment.

jobs.occupation: PhD scholarship in Coastal Engineering (Wave-Vegetation Interaction) - DTU Construct
jobs.description:
How can coastal vegetation help protect our coastlines from waves and flooding? Understanding how waves interact with vegetation is key to exploring its potential for coastal protection and climate adaptation. Are you interested in combining fluid mechanics, mathematical analysis and numerical modelling to help answer this question.

Then join us for a 3-year PhD fellowship in coastal engineering at the Technical University of Denmark (DTU), Department of Civil and Mechanical Engineering, Section for Fluid Mechanics, Coastal and Maritime Engineering.

Your PhD research will play an integral part in the project “Marine advection and dissipation in the vegetated coastal environment”, financed by the Independent Research Fund Denmark.

You will collaborate with researchers at DTU and DHI in Denmark, as well as at University College Dublin, Ireland and Northeastern University, USA.

Responsibilities 
Your primary tasks will be to develop analytical and numerical models for waves interacting with coastal vegetation. Particular emphasis will be placed on the wave-averaged flow generated by surface waves and on the changes introduced by vegetation canopies.

The research will include:

• Development and validation of models for wave-induced mean velocity profiles over vegetated beds under regular waves.
• Extension of these models to irregular wave fields, including derivation of wave-averaged shear-stress distributions and mean velocity profiles.
• Investigation of undertow and circulation currents above vegetated beds in the surf zone under breaking waves.
• Development of a cross-shore momentum balance describing wave-induced changes in mean water level and the potential reduction of storm-surge flooding by coastal vegetation.
• Numerical simulations using computational fluid dynamics 
• Application of advanced turbulence models for surface-wave flows, modified to account for vegetation.
• Validation of the developed models against existing high-quality laboratory datasets.
• Development of practical parameterizations suitable for implementation in larger-scale coastal and hydrodynamic models.
The project combines fundamental fluid mechanics with applications directly relevant to coastal protection and climate adaptation. A major scientific objective is to move beyond conventional empirical vegetation models and instead explicitly account for the modification of the wave-induced velocity field within and above vegetation canopies.

Qualifications
We are looking for candidates with a strong background in one or more of the following areas:

• Coastal or ocean engineering
• Fluid mechanics or hydrodynamics
• Computational fluid dynamics
• Environmental hydraulics
• Applied mathematics or a closely related field
Experience with numerical modelling, programming and/or CFD is highly desirable. Experience with turbulence modelling, wave mechanics or coastal hydrodynamics would be advantageous, but is not essential. Strong mathematical skills and an interest in combining theoretical analysis with numerical modelling are important.

You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.

Approval and Enrolment 
The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education. 

We offer
DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.

Salary and appointment terms
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Please see DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures.

The period of employment is 3 years. Starting date is anticipated as 1 February 2027, or according to mutual agreement. The position is a full-time position. 

You can read more about career paths at DTU here.

Further information 
Further information may be obtained from Professor David R. Fuhrman (drfu@dtu.dk).

You can read more about Department of Civil and Mechanical Engineering at www.construct.dtu.dk.

If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU. 

Application procedure 
Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 10 November 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:

• A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
• Curriculum vitae 
• Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale
You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it. 

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

DTU Civil and Mechanical Engineering develops and utilises science and technical knowledge for the benefit of society and the sustainable development. We undertake research, education, innovation, and scientific advice of the highest quality within building design and processes, building construction and safety, building energy and technical services, solid mechanics, fluid mechanics, coastal and maritime engineering, materials technology, manufacturing engineering, engineering systems design, design for sustainability, and thermal energy.

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

jobs.occupation: AI Red Team Specialist – Lead Researcher in Agentic Security
jobs.description:
We’re looking for an experienced red teamer with proven credentials in agentic red teaming to join our advanced product and research team.

What you’ll do

You’ll join the team dedicated to building and developing a tool that dynamically tests and evaluates large language models (LLMs) and their native application context for vulnerabilities.

You’ll be working with seasoned reverse engineers, application pentesters, red teamers, and data scientists, bridging multiple digital disciplines by creating a unique suite that gives our clients the capability to test, remediate, and harden their agentic workloads.

What you’ll bring

Most of all, we value ingenuity, curiosity, and drive. You may be a great fit for this role if you have experience with:

• Building or contributing to tools used for dynamic application testing

• Working extensively with open source or proprietary tools used for web and application pentesting

• Actively adopting LLMs and Model Context Protocol (MCP) in automating and enhancing your penetration tests

• Spending time researching agentic vulnerabilities and attending relevant trainings or conferences

To fit right in here at The Tech Collective:

• You should be genuinely curious about new developments within the red teaming domain

• You possess the willingness to tackle new and technical challenges as they arise

• You know how to break down and structure complex assignments and enjoy sharing your knowledge and insights with your team members

• You possess a startup mentality to help drive the innovation and ingenuity of our red team products

• You can cooperate seamlessly with different profiles in a highly diverse team of researchers, developers, consultants, and red teamers

We don’t expect you to know everything – after all, agentic security is a rapidly evolving field! In this role, we’re looking for someone who wants to own, develop, and innovate the product modules related to testing the application context (e.g., API security, cryptographic implementation, broken authentication, RBAC) and supporting infrastructure (e.g., misconfigurations, server-side vulnerabilities) for the agents that we test.

To succeed in this role, your experience and competencies should include:

Professional experience

• A minimum of five years’ progressive experience in enterprise red teaming or offensive research

• A proven track record of web application pentesting with an emphasis on remediation and hardening

• Experience defining and driving product roadmaps for red team tools (not required, but highly valued)

• Demonstrated ability to evaluate complex technology stacks, including common cloud platforms (M365/Azure, Google, or AWS), CI/CD pipelines, and AI-powered platforms and systems

• Experience communicating technical findings to non-technical stakeholders and the ability to bring technical assessments to life

Technical competencies

• Familiarity with both Mitre and OWASP frameworks, and experience applying them in client reporting

• Relevant security certifications (e.g., OSCP, OSCE, OSEP, GIAC GPEN/GXPN, etc.) are a plus, indicating solid foundational knowledge and commitment to the offensive security field.

• Prior experience developing agent-specific attack types such as prompt injection, memory & context poisoning, or jailbreaking

• A working understanding of MCP, LLM pipelines, the functional aspects of LLMs, and how modern agent solutions are integrated with widely used cloud suites such as M365 or AWS

Finally, experience in intermediate to advanced vulnerability research related to applications or operating systems will be considered a strong plus, but is not a requirement for this role.

What we offer

On top of a competitive salary and bonus package, we offer you the opportunity to join a unique team of experts and enthusiasts in your field. Our expectations are matched by our willingness to invest in your development – whether through training, conferences, or the opportunity to pursue research in areas you’re passionate about.

We combine remote work with meaningful co-working at our offices in Copenhagen and will provide you with the tooling and hardware required to reach our goal of building a unique red team platform.

For questions or enquiries, feel free to contact Anders Rømer Skøtt at anrs@thetechcollective.eu // +45 31717487.

Turn strategy into action. Turn data into decisions. Help deliver SGL’s most important agenda.

Are you ready to help shape SGL’s next chapter?

Scan Global Logistics is entering a decisive phase. Our strategy and major initiatives are in place. The priority now is to convert ambition into disciplined execution, measurable results and lasting change across our global organisation.

We are therefore looking for an exceptional Transformation Analyst to join the Chief Transformation Office. This is not a traditional reporting or PMO role. You will become a trusted analytical partner to the Chief Transformation Officer and help run the enterprise execution system behind SGL’s transformation agenda.

You will work close to the decisions that matter, with direct exposure to executive leadership, regional and functional leaders, and selected representatives of our private equity owners. Your analysis will help determine priorities, challenge assumptions, resolve performance gaps and accelerate value realisation.

The role is ideal for a highly analytical, commercially minded individual who wants exceptional responsibility, visibility and development potential early in their career.

What you can expect

• A front-row seat to one of SGL’s highest-priority enterprise agendas, spanning strategy execution, operating performance, integration, shared services, AI-enabled transformation and organisational development.

• Direct reporting to the Chief Transformation Officer and frequent interaction with SGL’s senior leaders across functions, regions and countries.

• Exposure to our private equity owners and preparation of fact-based insights for executive, owner and Board-level discussions.

• A steep learning curve with room to grow into broader transformation, strategy, programme or leadership responsibilities.

• A global, entrepreneurial environment where pace is high, decisions matter and strong ideas are expected to translate into action.

Your role

You will combine rigorous analysis with hands-on execution support. You will not only describe what is happening. You will help establish what should happen next, who owns it and how SGL follows through.

Portfolio intelligence and executive insight

• Maintain a clear, fact-based view of the enterprise transformation portfolio, including priorities, milestones, interdependencies, resources, risks and decisions required.

• Integrate financial, operational and initiative data into concise insights and recommendations for the Chief Transformation Officer and senior stakeholders.

• Identify emerging performance gaps, challenge underlying assumptions and translate complex information into clear choices and actions.

• Prepare high-quality dashboards, decision papers and materials for executive leadership, owner and Board-level discussions.

Value realisation and performance management

• Build and challenge business cases, baselines, targets and benefit logic for major transformation initiatives.

• Track value delivery against plan and work with Finance and initiative owners to strengthen data quality, accountability and transparency.

• Perform variance, productivity, cost, cash and operational analyses and turn findings into practical actions.

• Help create one source of truth for transformation performance and ensure that reporting supports decisions rather than administration.

Execution and transformation support

• Support the governance and operating cadence across the transformation agenda, including preparation, action tracking, escalation and decision follow-through.

• Work directly with initiative owners and regional or functional leaders to clarify plans, unblock issues and strengthen execution discipline.

• Analyse cross-functional dependencies and capacity constraints and propose pragmatic sequencing or trade-offs.

• Take ownership of selected high-priority analyses and workstreams from problem definition through recommendation and implementation follow-up.

Chief Transformation Officer support

• Act as a trusted analytical partner to the Chief Transformation Officer on priority topics, stakeholder discussions and rapid-response assignments.

• Help connect the strategy, the transformation portfolio and the performance agenda into one coherent executive view.

• Contribute to communication of priorities, progress and the case for change across SGL.

• Bring energy, intellectual curiosity and constructive challenge to a small team with a broad enterprise mandate.

Who we are looking for

We are looking for someone with unusual analytical strength and the ambition to become a transformation leader. You combine precision and structure with business judgment, curiosity and the confidence to engage senior stakeholders.

• 5+ years of high-performance experience from management consulting, corporate strategy, transformation, transaction services, FP&A, business intelligence or a similar analytical environment.

• Advanced analytical and financial modelling skills, including the ability to build business cases, interpret operational performance and test value-creation assumptions.

• Excellent PowerPoint and Excel capabilities; experience with Power BI, Power Apps or other visualization tools is an advantage.

What will make you successful

• You take ownership and deliver high-quality work at pace.

• You are intellectually rigorous without making simple issues complicated.

• You challenge constructively and remain pragmatic about what it takes to deliver in an operating business.

• You build credibility through facts, follow-through and strong stakeholder relationships.

• You are motivated by impact, learning and the opportunity to help shape a developing function.

Why join Scan Global Logistics?

At SGL, you will join an international logistics company with an entrepreneurial culture, high ambitions and a strong belief that results are created by people who take responsibility. Our DNA is built on Respect, Integrity, Entrepreneurship & Fun.

This role offers a rare combination of analytical depth, senior exposure and practical influence. You will help build the capabilities, governance and insight required to turn SGL’s ambitions into measurable value, while developing your own career alongside the agenda.

The transformation agenda is not a side project. It is a central priority for SGL, and this role will be at the heart of making it happen.

Interested?

Send your CV and application through the SGL career portal. We review applications on an ongoing basis and will close the process when the right candidate has been found.

For further information, please contact Nikolaj Lei Jacobsen, Chief Transformation Officer , +45 5339 2364 or visit www.scangl.com.

Scan Global Logistics is a Global full-service logistics provider headquartered in the Nordic, who excel in uncomplicating logistics through tailored solutions made by skilled specialists, proud problem-solvers and passionate entrepreneurs.

Since 1975, the core of our DNA has been a ‘can-do-attitude’, agility and the willingness to always go the extra mile and we are not afraid to go left when others go right. For us, every challenge is an opportunity. We go above and beyond to bring anything to anywhere – whether by road, rail, ocean, air or any other modes of transportation.

An internship at CERTA Intelligence & Security will give you the opportunity to gain insight into the work of identifying, preventing, and addressing security threats and risks that affect the activities, employees, and reputation of private corporations.

At the same time, the internship will allow you to test your skills in an environment of researchers, analysts, and advisors with experience from, among other places, national intelligence and security services.

As an intern at CERTA, you will be an integral part of the team you are assigned to and will be given a supervisor. The specific tasks you will be responsible for will vary depending on the team you join.

CERTA offers ongoing internships in each of the following areas:

• Intelligence collection and analysis

• Security consulting

Duration and Application Deadlines

We are looking for interns twice a year, and the internship lasts for six months:

• Spring (February 1st – July 31st)

• Application period is October 15th to November 15th the previous year

• Autumn (August 1st – January 31st)

• Application period is April 15th to May 15th

Requirements

You must be a student enrolled in a higher education institution at the bachelor’s or master’s level. Your application should specify whether the internship can be credited toward your degree and if you will receive student grants (SU) during the internship.

It is not a requirement that you are a Danish citizen or that you speak and write Danish fluently, although it may be beneficial if you understand Danish to some extent.

Qualifications

We are looking for students with strong analytical skills and methodological abilities, dedication, as well as a curious, open, and positive approach to problem-solving. Please include good examples of these qualifications in your application. Additionally, we expect you to have good English skills and preferably knowledge of other languages, as well as being IT proficient, including familiarity with the MS Office suite (PowerPoint, Excel, and Word).

The internship should contribute to your education and will take place under the guidance of an academic staff member at CERTA Intelligence & Security. We recommend that you check in advance what academic requirements your educational institution has regarding an internship.

Vacation and Working Hours

The average working hours are 37 hours per week (excluding lunch break). You will accrue 2.08 vacation days for each month of your internship, totalling 12.5 days during your 6-month internship. If your study program requires you to write a major academic assignment in connection with your internship, you may also receive writing leave of up to 10 days, depending on the scope and complexity of the assignment.

Application

You can apply for an internship at CERTA Intelligence & Security by submitting a written and motivated application to internship@certaintelligence.com during the application period. When applying for an intern position, you must include your CV along with your diploma/grades. You may also choose to attach other relevant documents, such as references from employers or educational institutions.

Your motivated application should be written in English and not exceed one page, and it should include a description of why you want an internship, what you hope to gain from the internship, and what relevant experience and skills you have for the specific intern position.

It should be clearly stated in your application which area (“Intelligence collection and analysis” or “Security consulting”) you are applying for an intern position.

You may be invited to an interview regarding your application, and no later than two months before the start of the internship (December 1st or June 1st), you will receive a response about whether we can offer you an internship position.

jobs.occupation: Business Controller, Netcompany DK FP&A Team
jobs.description:
Stillingsbeskrivelse

We are looking for a driven Business Controller with a strong motivation for FP&A to join Netcompany DK. You are either a recent graduate or have 1–3 years of experience, and you will play a central role in ensuring timely and accurate management reporting, as well as in-depth analyses of our business and financial KPIs. You will become part of a dynamic team where collaboration across departments and with different stakeholders is a natural part of everyday life.

Your responsibilities

You will become part of a well-functioning and collaborative team where you will have plenty of opportunities to share ideas, learn from colleagues, and grow professionally. Working closely with the Head of Finance NBS and DK, you will take ownership of key aspects of the monthly financial reporting to management. This includes following up on our business areas and preparing presentations.

In addition to being responsible for your own areas, you will have a broad range of stakeholders, where collaboration with the other Shared Services departments in the business is an important part of the role. The position will give you unique insight into the financial value drivers of the company and an understanding of the financial parameters that drive a business.

Your responsibilites will typically include:

• Conducting business analyses

• Comment on monthly reports for your areas of responsibility

• Contributing to the continuous improvement of the monthly reporting process

• Participating with your own areas of responsibility in the development of our system structure

• Actively participating in the budgeting and forecasting processes

About you

As a person, you are motivated by working with both complex and operational tasks, and you possess the ability to communicate across the organization. You have a proactive mindset and strong business acumen, combined with excellent analytical skills. You take initiative, identify opportunities for improvement, and are motivated by contributing to the development of the organization. jobs.occupation: PhD scholarship in Arctic fjord food webs under glacial retreat - DTU Aqua
jobs.description:
Greenland Institute of Natural Resources (GINR), the Greenland Climate Research Centre (GCRC) and DTU Aqua invite applications for a joint PhD position investigating how glacial retreat affect the structure, functioning, and stability of Arctic fjord food webs.

The position offers an excellent opportunity to combine Arctic field ecology, laboratory analyses, quantitative trophic ecology, and ecosystem modelling while working in Greenland and Denmark. You will become part of an interdisciplinary research environment spanning GINR, DTU Aqua, and the wider EDGE project.

The PhD project focuses on two contrasting fjord systems near Nuuk, Greenland, which differ in their degree of glacial influence. It is part of the Independent Research Fund Denmark project “Fjords on the EDGE: Resilience of Greenland Coastal Food Webs in a Warming Arctic”.

The overall aim is to understand how changes at the glacier–ocean interface propagates through the coastal ecosystem, from primary production to benthic communities, fish, and marine mammals. In particular, you will investigate the relative importance of benthic and pelagic energy pathways for key consumers using stable isotope analyses and stomach-content data. These observations will be integrated into an ecosystem model to explore how deglaciation tipping points may alter food-web structure and ecosystem functioning.

The position is jointly hosted by GINR in Nuuk and DTU Aqua in Lyngby. You will be based in Nuuk during the first two years and at DTU Aqua in Lyngby during the final year. Fieldwork, courses, project meetings, and collaborations will take place at additional locations throughout the PhD. You will be enrolled as a PhD student at DTU Aqua and work closely with researchers at both institutions and with collaborators in the EDGE project.

Responsibilities and qualifications
Your primary responsibilities will be to:

• Conduct fieldwork in Nuup Kangerlua and Ameralik during 2027, collecting benthic and pelagic samples.
• Prepare and analyse samples for stable isotope analysis and use isotope mixing models to quantify the relative contribution of benthic and pelagic food sources to key consumers.
• Conduct fish stomach-content analyses to characterise diets and trophic interactions.
• Integrate new observations with existing datasets to develop and parameterise an ecosystem model based on the StratE2E framework.
• Use the model to investigate how glacial retreat and associated changes in pelagic production may affect fjord food-web structure, functioning, and stability.
• Publish results in international peer-reviewed journals and present findings at scientific conferences and to relevant local stakeholders.
We are looking for a highly motivated candidate with a strong interest in Arctic marine ecosystems and interdisciplinary research. You should have:

• A two-year master’s degree (120 ECTS) in marine biology, marine ecology, fisheries science, ecosystem modelling, or a related field, with good academic results.
• A strong interest in fieldwork and laboratory-based research, including the ability to work effectively on ocean-going research vessels in Arctic environments.
• Demonstrated experience with quantitative data analysis and scientific programming in R, Python, or MATLAB.
• Knowledge of marine ecosystem dynamics and trophic or food-web ecology.
• Strong analytical and scientific communication skills.
• Fluency in written and spoken English.
The following qualifications are considered an advantage:

• Experience with ecological or ecosystem modelling, including StratE2E or similar frameworks.
• Experience with stable isotope ecology and/or mixing models.
• Experience identifying benthic organisms.
• Experience with fish diet or stomach-content analyses.
• Experience with Arctic marine ecosystems.
• A published or submitted peer-reviewed scientific publication.
• Fluency in Danish and Greenlandic.
We recognise that candidates may bring different combinations of these skills and do not expect applicants to have prior experience in all components of the project. Particular emphasis will be placed on scientific potential.

You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.

Approval and Enrolment 
The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education. 

Assessment
The assessment of the applicants will be made by Professor Teunis Jansen (DTU Aqua and GINR) and Researcher Sandra Maier (GINR).

We offer
DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.

Salary and appointment terms 
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Please see DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures

The position is a full-time, three-year PhD appointment administered by DTU. The expected starting date is 1 February 2027. You will be based at GINR in Nuuk during the first two years and at DTU Aqua in Lyngby during the final year. GINR will assist the successful candidate with finding accommodation in Nuuk.

You can read more about career paths at DTU here.

Further information
For further information, please contact Professor Teunis Jansen, DTU Aqua and GINR (tej@aqua.dtu.dk), or Researcher Sandra Maier, GINR (sama@natur.gl)

If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU. 

Application procedure 
Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 30 November 2026 (23:59 Danish time). 

Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:

• A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
• Curriculum vitae 
• Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale
You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it. 

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

About DTU Aqua
DTU Aqua – National Institute of Aquatic Resources – works for well-functioning oceans, rivers, and lakes where biodiversity can thrive. Our research, advisory service, and education contribute to the development of a sustainable blue bioeconomy, robust aquatic ecosystems, and reduced effects of climate change. We have a large national and international network and cooperate with research partners, public authorities, industry, and NGOs. We have state-of-the-art research facilities and Denmark’s only ocean- and arctic-going research vessel. The Institute has about 400 employees, one-half being scientific staff, including about 45 PhD students. About 40 nationalities are represented at the institute, and we support an equal gender distribution. We are located in Lyngby, Hirtshals, Nykøbing Mors, and Silkeborg and have regular activities in Greenland. Learn more on aqua.dtu.dk

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

jobs.occupation: Tenure Track Assistant Professor in Infectious Animal Disease Modelling for Sustainable One Health Actions
jobs.description:
Tenure Track Assistant Professor in Infectious Animal Disease Modelling for Sustainable One Health Actions  Department of Veterinary and Animal Sciences
 Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences
 University of Copenhagen

  The University seeks to appoint a tenure track assistant professor to commence 1 May 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. 

  Information on the department can be found at: http://www.sund.ku.dk/. 

  Subject area: Infectious disease epidemiology, modelling, animal health, One Health, and sustainable health systems

  The Tenure-Track Assistant Professor will lead research on the dynamics of infectious disease spread in health systems, with particular emphasis on how changes in environmental conditions, animal populations, production systems, and management practices influence disease emergence, transmission, and control. The position will combine infectious disease epidemiology, mathematical and statistical modelling, data science, and economic analysis to generate evidence supporting disease preparedness, prevention, and control.

  The successful candidate will:

   	
• Lead independent research on the dynamics of infectious disease spread in health systems, including the influence of environmental and production system changes. 	
• Develop and apply simulation, epidemiological, and statistical models to assess disease and spillover risks, evaluate mitigation and control strategies, and quantify their economic implications. 	
• Demonstrate strong programming skills in R and other relevant programming languages, including experience in managing, processing, and analysing large and complex datasets. 	
• Have experience in developing and applying epidemiological disease-spread models, including model calibration, validation, parameter estimation, and calculation of epidemiological indicators such as the basic reproduction number (R₀) across different animal species and production systems. 	
• Design and implement epidemiological modelling frameworks. 	
• Validate and calibrate models using large-scale national datasets, ensuring scientific robustness, methodological validity, and relevance for policy and decision-making. 	
• Translate research findings into evidence supporting risk-based disease prevention, preparedness, and control.  	
• Establish and maintain collaborations with key stakeholders, including the Danish Veterinary and Food Administration, industry partners such as SEGES and Landbrug & Fødevarer (L&F), and international organisations such as the FAO. 	
• Lead and secure independent research funding through competitive national and international funding calls. The position requires demonstrated experience in securing external funding, as well as the ambition to develop research ideas into externally funded projects and provide scientific leadership for such projects within the TIPTON Research Group. 	
• Contribute to the development and delivery of One Health and sustainability teaching, with a particular focus on infectious diseases, disease preparedness, and the interactions between animal, human, and environmental health. 	
• Contribute to teaching in data science, including data management, dataset preparation and handling, statistical analysis, programming, and the analysis of large-scale and complex datasets. 	
• Supervise students and contribute to research capacity building within infectious disease epidemiology, disease modelling, data science, and One Health. 	
• Contribute to the delivery of government services undertaken by the Department, including research-based advice, preparedness activities, risk assessments, and other activities relevant to infectious disease modelling and control.   The position is expected to combine methodological excellence in infectious disease modelling and data science with applied epidemiological research, generating evidence that is directly relevant to disease preparedness, private and public bodies, sustainable production systems, animal health and resilient health systems.

  The tenure track assistant professor’s responsibilities will primarily consist of: 

   	
• research, including publication/academic dissemination 	
• research-based teaching  	
• sharing knowledge with society  	
• participation in formal pedagogical training programme for assistant professors    The tenure track assistant professor’s performance will be evaluated through annual evaluations. Furthermore, the tenure track assistant professor will be evaluated in a mid-track appraisal. 

  After no more than six years of employment and on condition of a positive final appraisal, the tenure track assistant professor will be employed as associate professor. Find more information about tenure track at the University of Copenhagen.

  Required qualifications 
 To be qualified for an assistant professor position, you will be assessed according to these five overall criteria for recognising merit at the University of Copenhagen: Research, teaching, innovation & societal impact, organisational contribution and leadership. Find information about each criterion.

  Furthermore, each applicant must be able to document:

   	
• a PhD degree or similar qualifications within the subject area  	
• research experience within the field of the position    The tenure track assistant professor must have an academic standing showing internationally competitive research, and/or have internationally recognized high potential to make a future impact. 

  The assistant professor is also required to possess good interpersonal and communicative skills. 

  Salary and employment conditions
 The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week.

  The position is permanent. 

  Employment is as Tenure Track Assistant Professor under the applicable collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (Danish Confederation of Professional Associations) or other relevant professional organisations. 

  There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector at www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

  The position is covered by the Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities 2025. 

  Questions 
 For further information, please contact Research Group Leader: Professor Beate Conrady, bcon@sund.ku.dk

  Foreign applicants may find the university’s International Staff Mobility useful.

  Application 
 The application must be submitted in English, and must include the following documents: 

   	
• Application (Including motivation for applying for this position (Maximum 2 pages)) 	
• Curriculum vitae (Including information about external funding) 	
• Diplomas (Master’s, PhD and other relevant diplomas) 	
• A complete list of publications  	
• Research plan (2-4 pages) 	
• Teaching plan 	
• Uploads of maximum 5 publications to be considered in the assessment  	
• Teaching portfolio, if applicable (Guidelines)   Please note: It is mandatory to upload a teaching plan in the online application form. Should you not be able to produce a teaching plan, please upload a blank document in this box instead.

  Application procedure
 After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Appointments Committee.  All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment. The Dean then appoints an expert assessment committee in order to make an assessment of the selected applicants for the specific post. Selected applicants are notified of the composition of the committee and each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself. You can read about the recruitment process at the university's Job Portal.

  Please note that the applicant will be contacted if the assessment committee requires further documentation. 

  The application will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities. 

  The University of Copenhagen encourages all interested in this post to apply. 

  Please submit the application with the required attachments. Only online applications will be accepted. The closing date for applications is 23.59 p.m. CET, 18 November 2026.

  Interviews for this position are likely to be held on 7 April 2027.

Job Description

At Netcompany, we are looking for recent graduates with a bachelor’s degree who want a challenging, social and developing start to their career as an Associate Consultant. Are you excited by the opportunity to work on complex IT solutions that make a real impact, while combining hands-on development with project delivery and close client interaction?

The Associate Consultant role exists across both Consulting and Application Services. The main difference lies in how you work with clients and solutions, and which setup fits your interests best. Either a more project-oriented environment (Consulting) or a more long-term, team- and solution-driven setup (Application Services).

Responsibilities & technologies

As an Associate Consultant at Netcompany, you will contribute to translating customer needs into the right technical solutions. Depending on the project and customer, you may become part of either our Application Services or Consulting business area. In both areas, you will work closely with exciting customers and colleagues to develop and deliver high-quality IT solutions. Your work will span different projects, technologies, and domains, giving you the opportunity to continuously expand your knowledge and expertise. We work with a wide range of technologies and platforms, such as .NET, C#, Java, React, Angular, Salesforce, Microsoft, Oracle, Adobe and more.

As an Associate Consultant, you will contribute to all aspects of system development with focus on technical tasks. Your tasks and responsibilities will vary from project to project and evolve over time, but your responsibilities will typically include:

• Customer dialogue and requirements clarification.

• Development of frontend and backend features for customer solutions.

• Setup and development of frameworks, integrations, and extensions for standard platforms.

• Automation of business processes through, for example, batch jobs.

• Development of tools and scripts for data migration and other technical solutions.

About you

We expect you to hold a bachelor's degree or diploma in engineering, computer science, software, IT, or a similar field. To succeed in this role, you:

• Are newly graduated or have a couple of years of experience. Most importantly, you are passionate about taking your IT career to the next level.

• Possess strong IT technical skills within object-oriented programming.

• Have fundamental knowledge of software development and are motivated to develop your competencies.

• Think analytically, show initiative, and work in a structured way.

• Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will guide you through your development and help you achieve your goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague helps ensure the well-being of each employee and provides you with concrete insights into the many different career opportunities as you build your experience.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars on everything from technologies to customer management. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills, preparing you for various tasks and continuously improving your expertise throughout your career with us.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

Send us your application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance. #LI-SA1

At MFT Energy, we innovate energy trading through our people and technology.

Are you curious about how risk is managed in one of the fastest-moving industries in the world? At MFT Energy, we are looking for a Student Risk Analyst who wants to gain hands-on experience working with data and risk management in a dynamic energy trading environment.

The role as a Student Risk Analyst:

You will join our Finance, Risk & Treasury department, where you will be part of our Risk team working alongside experienced colleagues with deep industry expertise. The team works closely with stakeholders across the trading organization to provide transparency on the company’s overall risk profile and support informed decision-making.

In a business characterized by rapidly changing market conditions and significant volatility, the Risk team helps ensure a responsible balance between risk and return across all our trading activities.

In this role, you will work with a wide range of datasets, including trade data and market price data that form the foundation of our risk calculations. Through this work, you will contribute to maintaining reliable risk data and develop a strong understanding of how risk management supports a modern energy trading company.

The position offers a steep learning curve in a fast-paced environment where no two days are the same.

Your key responsibilities:

• Working with large trade and market price datasets to ensure the quality of risk calculations

• Developing data quality checks within our in-house data models

• Improving existing tools and developing new solutions (primarily using SQL, Power BI, Power Automate, and Power Apps)

• Automating tasks related to reporting, data processing and analysis

• Supporting the risk business partners with daily ad hoc tasks and analysis

• Gaining exposure to different types of risks including liquidity, market, credit and operational risk

Your qualifications and personal skills:

• Currently enrolled in a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Economics, Finance, Mathematics or a similar field.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Ability to work independently and take initiative

• Coding skills are a plus but not required. The most important thing is an interest in learning, as much of the data work will involve SQL

• Interest in energy markets and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment

• Curious and open-minded approach to learning and problem-solving

Working in MFT Energy

At MFT Energy, we combine a startup mindset with the strength of a global organization. We believe in empowering individuals to make data-driven decisions in a fast-paced environment. We are around 200 employees working out of our headquarters in Scandinavian Center, Aarhus C, and from our international offices in Turkey, Australia, New York, Singapore, Japan, and several remote colleagues working from all over the world.

We offer:

• A 15–20-hour student position with flexibility to plan your working hours around your studies

• A role where you will take ownership of your tasks while working closely with experienced colleagues who are always ready to support and spar with you

• An international and fast-moving environment where things develop quickly and you will continuously learn new things

• A strong student community and plenty of social activities, such as CrossFit, running club, Friday bars, team events, and more

• A culture where we enjoy celebrating both big and small successes - and luckily, we have many reasons to do so

Make the most of your talent! Join us!

If you think there is a fit between the role and your aspirations, we will be looking forward to receiving your application with a short cover letter and CV. For questions, please write to career@mft-energy.com.

Deadline: We will be screening and interviewing candidates on an ongoing basis.

Start date: As soon as possible.
